# windows_firewall_profile (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of a Windows Defender Firewall profile (`Domain`, `Private` or `Public`) on a remote Windows host without managing it.

Group Policy owns the `ActiveStore` view: when a GPO manages a profile, the observed values can diverge from what the sibling resource writes (`PersistentStore`), and GPO-managed `NotConfigured` tri-states are reported as unset (`null`) rather than exposed as values.

Returns an error when the profile does not exist on the target host (profiles always exist, so this indicates a broken firewall stack).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Read the observed state of the Public profile (read-only, no lifecycle).
data "windows_firewall_profile" "public" {
  name = "Public"
}

output "public_inbound_action" {
  value = data.windows_firewall_profile.public.default_inbound_action
}

output "public_enabled" {
  value = data.windows_firewall_profile.public.enabled
}

# Inspect a profile managed by the windows_firewall_profile resource in the
# same configuration. The data source returns the observed live state,
# including GPO-managed NotConfigured tri-states (reported as null).
data "windows_firewall_profile" "managed" {
  name = windows_firewall_profile.private.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Firewall profile name on the target host. One of `Domain`, `Private`, `Public`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `allow_inbound_rules` (Boolean) Whether inbound rules are honoured, as observed on the host (null when GPO-managed `NotConfigured`).
- `allow_local_firewall_rules` (Boolean) Whether locally created firewall rules are honoured, as observed on the host.
- `allow_local_ipsec_rules` (Boolean) Whether locally created IPsec rules are honoured, as observed on the host.
- `allow_unicast_response_to_multicast` (Boolean) Whether unicast responses to multicast traffic are allowed, as observed on the host.
- `default_inbound_action` (String) Default inbound action, as observed on the host (`Allow`, `Block`, or `NotConfigured` when GPO-managed).
- `default_outbound_action` (String) Default outbound action, as observed on the host.
- `disabled_interface_aliases` (Set of String) Interfaces excluded from this profile, as observed on the host.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall is active for this profile, as observed on the host.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: the profile name (`Domain`, `Private` or `Public`).
- `log_allowed` (Boolean) Whether allowed connections are logged, as observed on the host.
- `log_blocked` (Boolean) Whether blocked connections are logged, as observed on the host.
- `log_file_name` (String) Path of the firewall log file, as observed on the host.
- `log_ignored` (Boolean) Whether ignored packets are logged, as observed on the host.
- `log_max_size_kilobytes` (Number) Maximum size of the firewall log file in kilobytes, as observed on the host.
- `notify_on_listen` (Boolean) Whether the user is notified when an application starts listening, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
